name: week
title: This week
subtitle: What needs a person: statutory deadlines, fairness gaps, cases gone quiet and warnings

sections.title: Against the law or guidance
sections.note: Statutory deadlines missed and refusals without what the law asks for. Each row names its source.
sections.sql: select ref, kind, problem, rule from v_case_problems where kind in ('law', 'guidance') order by ref

sections.title: Due in the next 7 days
sections.sql: select due_on, ref, obligation, title, handler, source from v_deadline_status where met_on is null and case_status <> 'closed' and due_on between current_date and current_date + 7 order by due_on, ref

sections.title: House rules
sections.note: Your own limits: acknowledging, answering, cases with no handler or untouched for too long.
sections.sql: select ref, problem from v_case_problems where kind = 'house' order by ref

name: deadlines
title: Deadlines
subtitle: Every dated obligation on an open case, soonest first

sections.title: Open obligations
sections.sql: select due_on, standing, ref, obligation, case_kind, title, handler, kind, source from v_deadline_status where met_on is null and case_status <> 'closed' order by due_on, ref

sections.title: Challenge windows still open
sections.note: After an adverse decision, how long the employee has to raise a grievance or apply to the Fair Work Commission.
sections.sql: select window_ends, ref, person, decision, rule from v_windows where window_ends >= current_date order by window_ends

name: cases
title: Open cases
subtitle: Every case not yet closed. Protected disclosures never show who raised them.

sections.title: Cases
sections.sql: select ref, kind, title, person, raised_by, handler, status, received_on, age_days from v_cases where status <> 'closed' order by received_on, ref

sections.title: Who is carrying what
sections.sql: select coalesce(handler, '(no handler)') as handler, count(*)::int as open_cases, max(age_days) as oldest_days from v_cases where status <> 'closed' group by handler order by open_cases desc

name: warnings
title: Warning register
subtitle: Every warning in force, soonest to expire first

sections.title: Live warnings
sections.sql: select person_code as code, person, team, level, issued_on, expires_on, days_left, ref from v_warnings where standing = 'live' order by expires_on

sections.title: Expired or withdrawn in the last 12 months
sections.sql: select person, level, issued_on, expires_on, standing, withdrawn_reason from v_warnings where standing <> 'live' and expires_on >= current_date - 365 order by expires_on desc
